notes: New look! Light mode is now Gulmohar (warm cream, coral buttons, teal accents, soft big-rounded cards) and dark mode is Midnight Console (deep charcoal with a lime accent). Every screen reskinned — Dashboard, Scanner, Editor, Viewer, Vault, Bin, Settings. No feature changes: smart sync, ID-card mode, OCR, combine, password PDFs and signatures all work as before.
